name_reason: Fully compliant with global naming rule: data_fd2_ prefix, battle domain (battle viewport core state), descriptive cursor_world_y. The trailing 'y' is a semantic axis label (vertical/row), not Ghidra address residue (it is not a hex suffix equal to the address). Sibling of data_fd2_battle_cursor_world_x (0x53AB1) and data_fd2_battle_view_window_origin_y (0x53AAD), naming is consistent across the block.
purpose: Battle/field cursor position Y in world (map tile) coordinates -- the map row the cursor currently points at.
logic_summary: Runtime cursor state in BSS (uint32, dword). Distinct from cursor_screen_y (on-screen viewport row) and view_window_origin_y (viewport scroll origin). The vertical cursor-move handlers (fd2_cursor_move_up/down) move world_y together with either screen_y (inner step) or window_origin_y (scroll), keeping cursor world position consistent with the visible viewport. Read by all menu/targeting/paint code that needs the cursor's map row; pan helpers (fd2_pan_cursor_to_tile_animated, fd2_pan_cursor_and_window) drive it toward a target row. Initialized: zeroed by fd2_init_battle_state_for_chapter (MOV dword ptr [0x53AB5],0 as part of zeroing the cursor/window block 0x53AA9..0x53ABD), restored from the save header (pBuf[0x30C9]) by fd2_load_save_and_init_engine, and stored by chapter-end handlers. Range: small non-negative tile row 0..map_height_tiles-1.
element_semantics: Single scalar: cursor world Y = map tile row index (0-based). Bounded 0..data_fd2_battle_map_height_tiles-1 by the move handlers.
notes: Verified via disassembly: INC dword ptr [0x53AB5] in fd2_cursor_move_down (0x11BCC/0x11BDA), CMP EAX,dword ptr [0x53AB5] at 0x11BAB; MOV dword ptr [0x53AB5],0x0 at 0x20637 in fd2_init_battle_state_for_chapter (block zeroing 0x20619..0x2064B confirms init zeroes 0x53AA9..0x53ABD); save-load restore data_fd2_battle_cursor_world_y=pBuf[0x30C9] at 0x10403. Many writers -> not const. Existing src comment (cursor.c lines 301-313) and Ghidra data plate are both accurate and mutually consistent; no edit needed. No logic/equivalence concerns found.
